headlines.headline: Grizzlies send Ja Morant to Trail Blazers in offseason blockbuster
headlines.detail: Memphis traded Morant to Portland for Jerami Grant and Kris Murray, the third star the Grizzlies have moved on since their 2025 playoff sweep, following Desmond Bane and Jaren Jackson Jr.

headlines.headline: Seahawks turn to Drew Lock as Sam Darnold's hip injury sidelines him for Week 2
headlines.detail: Darnold is expected to miss Sunday's game at Arizona after exiting Seattle's 13-10 Week 1 win over New England; Lock (16-of-22, 187 yards, TD in relief) gets the start.

headlines.headline: Michigan stuns No. 11 Oklahoma 17-10 as No. 1 Ohio State-No. 4 Texas looms tonight
headlines.detail: The Wolverines' defense set up the game-winning score in the first ranked-team upset of the season, setting up tonight's marquee showdown between Ohio State and Texas in Austin.

headlines.headline: Arizona lands Clemson grad transfer RJ Godfrey ahead of 2026-27 season
headlines.detail: Godfrey averaged 12.0 points and 5.3 rebounds on 61%-plus shooting for Clemson last season and joins the Wildcats as the offseason transfer shuffle continues.
